resources.name: Wagner interaction parameters for carbon in austenite

access.notes: Contains numerical values of ∂lnγ_C/∂X_Cr, ∂lnγ_C/∂X_Ni, ∂lnγ_C/∂X_C, and γ°_C extracted from Heckler & Winchell (Trans. TMS-AIME, 1963) and Chipman & Brush (Trans. TMS-AIME, 1968). The file will be supplied as part of the task's public assets.

resources.notes: Required to evaluate the Wagner equation (ln γ_C = ln γ°_C + X_C·∂lnγ_C/∂X_C + X_Ni·∂lnγ_C/∂X_Ni + X_Cr·∂lnγ_C/∂X_Cr).

resources.name: Free energy of formation of Cr23C6

access.notes: Contains the Gibbs free energy of formation of Cr23C6 as a function of temperature from Richardson (J. Iron Steel Inst., 1953). Not required for the γ_C computation but available for extended reproduction.

resources.notes: Optional; listed for completeness per the paper's broader thermodynamic analysis.
